mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, NICKNAME, EMAIL, PROFILE) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{profile})
mapper.select: select count(*) from TB_MEMBER where MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
select MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, NICKNAME, EMAIL, PROFILE, to_char(CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "CREATE_AT_STR" from TB_MEMBER where MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
